column4: dialect-gated: cleat#2237's live-interleaving race test for handleIngestWebhook has postgres, mysql, mysql_read_committed and mssql_rcsi_on subtests. cleat-review's review of #2242 found the mysql and postgres subtests passed as no-ops (trivial PASS, no skip event) rather than skipping when their backend was absent -- the loop-over-testutil.NewPluginTestBackends shape that silently does nothing is exactly the "checks never started" trap CLAUDE.md warns about -- so all three optional subtests now call t.Skip explicitly, same shape as the pre-existing mssql_rcsi_on subtest already used. mysql and mysql_read_committed both need CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL (the latter forces transaction_isolation=READ-COMMITTED on the same DSN); mssql_rcsi_on needs CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL (forces READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT on in a private database, webhookingestPrivateRCSIDatabase). ci.yml's test-go/plugins job provides only PostgreSQL (CLEAT_TEST_DB), so all three skip there and postgres runs. Measured by name: go test ./plugins/webhookingest/... -run TestAnIngestRacingAnOpenDeleteTransactionIsBlocked -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset reports exactly these three, 3 -- not 1.
